messages:
maria: Heads up — weird microburst on 4th & Bryant, tiny hail and a streetcar reroute. Anyone on the K/T or 22 right now? Photo: http://imgur.com/abc123 :eyes:

josh: On the 22 inbound. Operator just announced a detour around a blocked lane, looks like +15–20m.

akiko: Walked past — saw city crew digging out a small curb sinkhole, traffic crawling. No injuries. Photo: http://imgur.com/def456

ben: Caltrain shows on time but getting to the station is a mess. Thinking of switching to rideshare.

commute-bot: SF MUNI alert: Route K/T detour due to roadway obstruction at 4th & Bryant. Estimated delay 12–18 min. https://status.sfmta.gov (automated)

olivia: Anyone still heading into the office? I can hold my garage spot for ~30m if someone needs it. :parking:

josh: Thanks @olivia — might take you up on that. @maria did hail do any damage?

maria: Kinda — tiny dent on my bike pannier, but my jacket did its job. Coffee saved me though. ☕️ :sweat_smile:

akiko: Quick poll — how did you get to work today? Reply with one emoji: 🚲 / 🚇 / 🚗 / 🚶 / 🛵

ben: 🚇

olivia: 🚗

josh: 🚲

maria: 🚶 (short sprint through the shower)

commute-bot: Tip: DM me 'subscribe commute' for realtime reroute pings and incident summaries.
